t: You're on Margaret Street, which straddles Marylebone and Fitzrovia in the West End. It runs from Cavendish Square to Wells Street, passing through Regent Street, Great Portland Street and Great Titchfield Street. It sits just north of Oxford Street and parallel to it. The street is named after Margaret Cavendish Bentinck, Duchess of Portland, who lived from 1715 to 1785. She was a naturalist, botanist and collector, and the richest woman in Great Britain of her time.
